item.title: Final Fantasy Resonance Reviews Beat Square Enix's Previous HD-2D RPG
item.description: Square Enix's HD-2D art style has captivated the hearts and eyeballs of RPG fans since 2018's Octopath Traveler, and now the company is bringing the aesthetic to its marquee franchise for the first time with Final Fantasy Resonance . The game pulls inspiration from the Final Fantasy Brave Exvius mobile game, which ran from 2015 to 2025. But Resonance eliminates all the gacha and microtransaction elements that existed in the free-to-play version, while adding a 16-bit-inspired overworld map and turn-based combat that calls back to the Final Fantasy series' early games.

item.title: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort Reviews Prove the Series Isn't Winning Any Awards
item.description: From a critical standpoint, Nintendo has had zero misses when it comes to first-party Switch 2 games in 2026. Each of its games this year has, at the very least, reviewed pretty well. That trend has continued with Nintendo Switch Sports Resort , which is receiving some kudos from critics who are finding lots of fun in the minigame collection. That reception shouldn't surprise you, though.

item.title: PS6 price update is bad news for millions of gamers
item.description: At launch, the price of a PlayStation 6 could be out of reach for many—if not most—gamers. Right now, the PS5 retails for about $200 more than it did at launch, due to the rising price of components. In particular, the skyrocketing cost of RAM, driven ever upwards by the massive demands of AI data centers, is having an outsized effect on the cost of consoles. Some are even speculating that a next-generation console, such as the PS6, could cost more than $1000.

item.title: James Gunn Officially Comments on the Status of DCU’s Batman and Flash
item.description: If you want to keep abreast of the latest news about the state of DC's cinematic universe, you might be surprised to find that you need to look at the social media site Threads. It's the preferred haunt of DC Studio boss James Gun n, who often shoots off responses to fan questions at random. Most recently, this brought to light some much-needed updates on some of the DC Universe's most anticipated characters.

item.title: Mike Flanagan Officially Confirms His Plan for The Dark Tower TV Series Adaptation
item.description: Stephen King’s The Dark Tower series has long been considered tough to adapt: With a complex multiverse of worlds spread across several lengthy novels, where do you even begin? According to Mike Flanagan , the man behind TV series like The Haunting of Hill House , Midnight Mass , and Prime Video’s recent adaptation of Carrie , the answer is surprisingly simple: you begin at the start.

item.title: James Gunn Officially Shuts Down Milly Alcock Supergirl Rumors
item.description: Since the launch of the new DC cinematic universe under James Gunn, the co-CEO of DC Studios has been under intense scrutiny from fans as he retools Warner Bros.' slate of superhero movies and TV shows. While Superman and Lanterns have been hits, this summer's Supergirl was an unqualified disaster for the fledgling DCU, leading to unsubstantiated speculation about another overhaul and votes of no confidence in Gunn. While Gunn and Peter Safran have received renewed trust in shepherding the DCU under Warner Bros. Discovery's new ownership, angry DC fans are always looking for vulnerabilities.

item.title: Rebel Ridge Director Reveals Official First Look at New Halloween Action-Thriller
item.description: The director of thrillers Green Room and Rebel Ridge , Jeremy Saulnier, returns with a new Halloween-set action thriller in 2027 with Slayground . Distributor A24 released the first trailer for Saulnier's new film on Tuesday, keeping much of the movie 's mystery alive. But we know that Slayground starts with a mass-casualty event at a haunted attraction and continues with a manhunt for the suspected killer.
